events.body: Natural gas producer Antero Resources (NYSE:AR) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 37.2% year on year to $1.90 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.15 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
